claims.claim: Direct Tokunbo Valeo Alternator for Mercedes-Benz M278 - 439741
claims.evidence: Photos show an alternator but no clearly readable Valeo/part number/M278 markings.
No shipping/origin documents or labels are readable in the photos.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show a test result (voltage/load/bench test) or mileage/never-open proof.

risks.risk: Wrong fit/part number (M278 vs another Mercedes engine) leading to non-compatibility or incorrect connector/clocking.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the alternator label/part number (including any Bosch/Valeo number) and the exact Mercedes VIN/engine code it was removed from.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used alternator with unknown compatibility (worst case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Not actually tested/working (could be weak output, diode failure, or intermittent fault).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of bench test or on-car test showing charging voltage at idle and RPM (and ideally load test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: treat as faulty/needs testing).

risks.risk: Internal damage not visible in photos (burnt diodes/regulator, worn bearings causing noise under load).
risks.proof: Ask for a video start/charging test where you can hear/observe bearing noise and show stable voltage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially noisy/defective until proven.

risks.risk: Connector/terminal condition (corrosion, broken pins, missing insulators) affecting installation.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of both electrical connectors/terminals and mounting points from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming standard used condition with possible minor electrical issues.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the alternator identification label showing brand (Valeo/Bosch), exact part number, and any stamped codes.
Photo of the connector side showing pin/terminal condition and any part-specific markings.
Video proof of testing: charging voltage at idle and at higher RPM (and/or bench test readout).
VIN or engine code of the vehicle it came from (to confirm M278 fit) and confirmation of the claimed part number 439741.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is an alternator, but the key details needed to price confidently (exact brand/part number/compatibility and verified working test results) are not readable or proven.
